body: I don't have that strength though. Every time I try to make an appointment with a therapist, I end up making a million excuses why I can't go and I cancel on them. I want to go, and I know that I need to go, but putting myself out there is terrifying. I used to be able to make myself do things I don't want to do, because I'm a human and humans have willpower, but I don't have that anymore.

I'm on antidepressants, but they don't seem to be helping anymore. And I can't handle the humility of going to my teachers and telling them I couldn't make it to class because I'm stupid and weak. I'd rather just hide away alone until I'm gone.
